purpose: Measure the decoder-quantization cost of this study's frozen core ONCE, on the same 400 rows and the same published protocol the sealed R-official-raw cell flew. Every Audio2Tool number this study has produced is a Q4_K_M number; the paper (arXiv:2604.22821 Table 3) ran the bf16 HF model. One cell, C-q8-official-raw, is byte-identical to R-official-raw in every request byte and every scoring rule, with exactly one difference: the decoder GGUF is the umbrella lock's Q8_0 file instead of the Q4_K_M requant, served with -ngl 999 plus --n-cpu-moe N because 32,484,494,336 bytes cannot be resident on a 24,463 MiB card. N was fixed model-free by the preregistered VRAM fit rule before any generation (placement receipt). The owner's 2026-09-04 GO calls this the closing model-usage check: the alignment axes that matter are the prompt, the way the model is used and the scoring script; the prompt and the scoring script are already the published ones, and quantization is the last controllable model-usage suspect. Preregistration: docs/readiness/2026-09-04-a2t-q8-quantization-probe-v1-preregistration.md.

population.strata: 50 samples per tier across all eight Audio2Tool tiers
population.selection: the frozen 400 split, no draw; already exposed by A0 (row SAEA-BASE-a2t-a0-400), by SAEA-A2T-DIRECT-CALIBRATION-V1 and by SAEA-A2T-OFFICIAL-PROTOCOL-REPLICATION-V1. Using it again is what makes the paired contrast against the sealed R-official-raw manifest possible at zero additional population cost.
population.estimand: equal-tier reporting, with the per-domain slices (wearables / smart_car / smart_home) reported beside it because every official-population verdict of 2026-09-04 found smart_home to be the weak stratum

cells.factor_c_quantization: Q8_0 decoder (umbrella lock key qwen3-omni-30b-a3b-instruct-gguf, 32,484,494,336 bytes) instead of the Q4_K_M requant, with the SAME bf16 mmproj file
cells.factor_a_output_contract: unchanged from R-official-raw: the published system message (the adapter's hard-coded default system prompt, the fixed '## Available Tools:' header, and format_tools_compact over the whole 152-row registry)
cells.factor_d_audio_path: raw audio, bf16 mmproj loaded, the SAME feature-cache directory the sealed Q4 cell used
cells.user_turn: audio first, then the fixed sentence 'Convert this voice command to a tool call.'
cells.serving_geometry: identical to the sealed R-official-raw cell's (-c 49152 -np 3, 16,384 tokens per slot); the model fragment is the single authority and its --n-cpu-moe value comes from the placement receipt

shared_protocol.harness: core.flight.FlightRuntime with the shared rails zero-supply direct arm and the OpenJiuwen executor -- the same harness the sealed R-official-raw cell flew, so the paired contrast differs only in the decoder quantization and the weight placement it forces
shared_protocol.placement_caveat: expert offload is a numerical-implementation detail, not a protocol factor: CPU and CUDA kernels accumulate in different orders, so rare greedy ties can flip. Recorded as a caveat in the verdict, never read as a factor.

execution_plan_basis.planned_model_calls: 400 items x 1 cell x 1 contact, plus 8 canaries
execution_plan_basis.planned_speech_audio_seconds: 2,159.688 s for one pass, rounded up to the integer contracts.ExecutionPlan requires; the registered ceiling is 2,300
execution_plan_basis.planned_gpu_hours: 3.0; the naive partial-offload measurement of August was 4.17x slower than resident Q4_K_M, but expert offload keeps attention on the GPU and the published prompt is 3.7x shorter than the reconstruction, so 3.0 h is a conservative plan against a 4.0 h registered ceiling. The 4-row smoke's wall-time projection is the binding pre-takeoff check: if it projects past the ceiling the flight does not take off and the owner is asked, rather than the roster being shrunk.
execution_plan_basis.ceilings_live_in_the_exposure_row: contracts.ExecutionPlan carries no ceiling field; the registered ceilings are the exposure-ledger row's calls / speech audio seconds / gpu hours cells, which the gate requires to be at least these planned values

metrics: official parameter precision/recall/F1, macro over samples as the published code computes it
parameter F1 micro-pooled, reported beside the macro figure
a2t-toolcall-v2 ordered tool accuracy, exact match and slot F1
GPU and host memory in use at the served placement
mandatory_slices: all eight tiers, with the paper row and a Wilson CI90 beside every tier
the paired contrast C-q8 minus R-official-raw over the same 400 rows, per tier and pooled, under the official scorer and under a2t-toolcall-v2
per-domain tables (wearables / smart_car / smart_home), natural mixture and equal-domain
parse rate and the count of rows whose response named more than one call
throughput: seconds per call, calls per second at the declared slots, model load seconds

decision.quantization_dominant: QUANTIZATION-DOMINANT: the pooled Q8 minus Q4 tool-accuracy CI90 lower bound is above 0 on the four acceptance tiers (1, 2, 5, 6) AND C-q8 is PASS or CONSISTENT-WITHIN-NOISE against the paper on those tiers.
decision.partial: PARTIAL: otherwise; report the fraction of each tier's gap closed by Q8 and stop.
decision.consequences: No outcome changes the operating core by itself, tunes any knob, or opens any test data. Q8_0 becoming the Audio2Tool operating core is a separate owner decision informed by the throughput this probe records.
decision.claim_surface: Nothing here is a superiority, generality or Stage-3 claim; the population is exposed discovery data; no knob is tuned on it.
decision.not_authorized: No test contact, no mechanism arm, no fresh roster, no Q5_K_M / Q6_K / IQ variants, no rebuild or checkout of the llama.cpp tree, no edit to the chat template, no packet-path cell, no second attempt beyond the one recovery re-registration.
